passMeaning: PASS closes only the reproducible F0.2b.3 audit dossier. The three assets remain quarantined and content certification remains blocked.

rows.scope: Dossier completeness and conservative disposition; not copyright clearance.
rows.findings: 3/3 assets remain unknown-quarantined. A directed non-exhaustive provenance search and eight candidate-source fetches do not establish authorship, ownership or authorization.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Authorship, rights basis, license or authorization evidence, factual human review and independent human approval remain unresolved.

rows.scope: Identity, fail-closed registry decisions, blind packets, first-pass trace and deterministic validation.
rows.findings: Object and passage hashes match baseline and registry; malformed or changed records quarantine. Recursive guards cover key names, key-like text values and learner/contact PII.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: The local first-pass hash is not an external append-only witness; runtime quarantine enforcement belongs to a later unit.

rows.scope: Complete independent audit of writer-view attribution and answerability; not bank certification.
rows.findings: The reviewer covered 22/22 statements and matched all stored labels, but identified 2 material ambiguities and rated all three passages mixed for IELTS fitness.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: ynng-station-art-07 and ynng-uniforms-04 require rewriting and independent re-adjudication before publication.

rows.scope: Prospective content-only simulation, not a real learner or UI study.
rows.findings: 3/3 passages and 22/22 statements have likely misread, evidence hunt, attribution check, decision rule and repair action recorded without assigned answers or bands.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: No claim of retention, band improvement, accessibility, usability or effectiveness with real students.

rows.scope: Detection and blocking, not statistical fairness certification.
rows.findings: Stored labels are YES=9, NO=8 and NOT GIVEN=5. A degree-language cue hits NO on 6/11 eligible statements; sequence, length, lexical overlap, attribution wording, title and qualitative risks are recorded.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: n=22 is below the certification threshold, two items are materially ambiguous and contentCertification remains blocked.

rows.scope: Not applicable to the learner-facing delta of F0.2b.3 only.
rows.findings: Catalog, route, ObjectivePracticeEngine and ObjectivePracticeSetBank hashes equal the pinned baseline; no app or component imports the audit registry or contract.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: This does not certify the existing UI, accessibility, Task 2 parity, shared layouts or product-wide behavior.

rows.scope: Not applicable because this audit-only unit introduces no scoped DOM, copy, interaction or runtime delta.
rows.findings: The exclusion is guarded by four baseline hashes and absence of audit imports from learner-facing runtime sources.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: No browser matrix, screenshots, traces or viewport evidence exists for this row, so it must never be represented as Playwright PASS.
